title: Fekola S.A.–B2Gold workers' 168-hour workplace stoppage
reason: The opened article describes a private employer conflict with demands directed to Fekola management, not Mali state policy; it reports no public street gathering or 50-person crowd.
notes: A press conference at the Bourse du Travail is mentioned but no attendance or state-directed demand is established. The stoppage crosses into December but is not split into a continuation observation.
